values.value: Subtract the Adjustment Parameter to the value. Applies to Integer, Long Integers, Big Integer, Interval, Date Time, and Date Time Extended. The default is parameter is 1 for numeric types, 1 second for Date Time, and 1 microsecond for Date Time Extended.

values.name: Negate
values.value: Negate the value. Applies to Integer, Long Integers, Big Integer and Boolean types.

values.name: Optional
values.value: The server MAY process each batch item in the request either asynchronously (returning an Asynchronous Correlation Value for a batch item) or synchronously. The method or policy by which the server determines whether or not to process an individual batch item asynchronously is a decision of the server and is outside of the scope of this protocol.

values.name: Prohibited
values.value: The server SHALL NOT process any batch item asynchronously. All batch items SHALL be processed synchronously.

values.name: Stop
values.value: If an operation fails, then the server SHALL NOT continue processing subsequent operations in the request. Completed operations SHALL NOT be undone. Batch item fails and Result Status is set to Operation Failed. Responses to other batch items are returned normally.

values.name: Continue
values.value: Return an error for the failed operation, and continue processing subsequent operations in the request. Batch item fails and Result Status is set to Operation Failed. Batch items that had been processed have been undone and their responses are returned with Undone result status.

values.name: Unable to Cancel
values.value: The cancel operation is unable to cancel the pending operation.

values.name: Completed
values.value: The pending operation completed successfully before the cancellation operation was able to cancel it.

values.name: Failed
values.value: The pending operation completed with a failure before the cancellation operation was able to cancel it.

values.name: Unavailable
values.value: Unavailable – The specified correlation value did not match any recently pending or completed asynchronous operations.

values.name: Server On-Demand
values.value: The server generates the client’s private key on demand. The returned PKCS#12 is protected with HEX(SHA256(Username || Password)).

values.name: Client Generated
values.value: The client generates the private key and sends a Certificate Signing Request to the server to generate the certificate. The returned PKCS#12 is protected with HEX(SHA256(Username || Password)).

values.name: Client Registered
values.value: The client generates the private key and the certificates and registers the certificate with the server.

values.name: HASH
values.value: This method derives a key by computing a hash over the derivation key or the derivation data.

values.name: HMAC
values.value: This method derives a key by computing an HMAC over the derivation data.

values.name: ENCRYPT
values.value: This method derives a key by encrypting the derivation data.

values.name: NIST800-108-C
values.value: This method derives a key by computing the KDF in Counter Mode

values.name: NIST800-108-F
values.value: This method derives a key by computing the KDF in Feedback Mode

values.name: NIST800-108-DPI
values.value: This method derives a key by computing the KDF in Double-Pipeline Iteration Mode

values.name: Asymmetric Key
values.value: This method derives a key using asymmetric key agreement between a private and public key.

values.value: As defined in Amazon Web Services Signature Version 4.

Opaque
values.value: an encoded key for which the encoding is unknown to the key management system. It is encoded as a string of bytes.

values.name: PKCS1
values.value: an encoded private key, expressed as a DER-encoded ASN.1 PKCS#1 object.

values.name: PKCS8
values.value: An encoded private key, expressed as a DER-encoded ASN.1 PKCS#8 object, supporting both the RSAPrivateKey syntax and EncryptedPrivateKey

values.name: X.509
values.value: An encoded object, expressed as a DER-encoded ASN.1 X.509 object.

values.name: ECPrivateKey
values.value: An ASN.1 encoded elliptic curve private key.

values.name: Several Transparent Key types
values.value: algorithm-specific structures containing defined values for the various key types.

values.name: Public Key Link
values.value: For a Private Key object: the public key corresponding to the private key. For a Certificate object: the public key contained in the certificate.

values.name: Certificate Link
values.value: For Certificate objects: the parent certificate for a certificate in a certificate chain. For Public Key objects: the corresponding certificate(s), containing the same public key.

values.name: Derivation Base Object Link
values.value: For a derived Symmetric Key or Secret Data object: the object(s) from which the current symmetric key was derived.

values.name: Derived Key Link
values.value: The symmetric key(s) or Secret Data object(s) that were derived from the current object.

values.name: Replacement Object Link
values.value: For a Symmetric Key, an Asymmetric Private Key, or an Asymmetric Public Key object: the key that resulted from the re-key of the current key. For a Certificate object: the certificate that resulted from the re-certify. Note that there SHALL be only one such replacement object per Managed Object.

values.name: Replaced Object Link
values.value: For a Symmetric Key, an Asymmetric Private Key, or an Asymmetric Public Key object: the key that was re-keyed to obtain the current key. For a Certificate object: the certificate that was re-certified to obtain the current certificate.

values.name: Parent Link
values.value: For all object types: the container or other parent object corresponding to the object.

values.name: Child Link
values.value: For all object types: the subordinate, derived or other child object corresponding to the object.

values.name: Previous Link
values.value: For all object types: the previous object to this object.

values.name: Next Link
values.value: For all object types: the next object to this object.

values.name: Wrapping Key Link
values.value: For wrapped objects: the object that was used to wrap this object.
